summary: Completed Module 04 Context: Identified public vs protected endpoint boundaries and articulated risks of open write/read surfaces.
evidence: Student identified GET /r/{code} as necessarily public for universal redirect reachability without friction.
Student identified POST /links and GET /links as requiring authentication to prevent denial-of-service spam and multi-tenant data exfiltration.
Student clearly distinguished between Authentication (identity verification) and Authorization (access enforcement and IDOR mitigation).
